name: Labor rights compliance
desc_html:
National compliance with labor rights — freedom of association and collective bargaining — measured against ILO textual sources and national legislation. This is SDG indicator 8.8.2.
A higher score means more violations, so lower is better: the scale runs from 0 for full compliance upward.

names: Violations of labor rights (0 = full compliance)

source_notes: Not an OECD table. Violations of labor rights (0 = full compliance): ILO, via SDG indicator 8.8.2, assembled and harmonised by Our World in Data.

Higher means worse. The indicator counts violations of freedom of association and collective bargaining rights in law and in practice, so 0 is full compliance and a rising line is a deteriorating one.
